<fidel-step-nav>

Big Previous and Next links. Previous and Next links at the end of a lesson, with "Lesson 3 of 8", at least 48 px tall.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners with tremor, one hand or a switch, who need large targets that say where they go.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-step-nav prev-href="lesson-2.html" prev-label="Lesson 2: Forms"
                next-href="lesson-4.html" next-label="Lesson 4: Tables"
                position="3" total="8"></fidel-step-nav>

Source: player/src/components/c/step-nav.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-step-nav>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
prev-href, prev-labelURL, textnoneThe previous lesson (no href, no link).
next-href, next-labelURL, textnoneThe next lesson.
position, totalnumbersnone"Lesson 3 of 8".
labeltext"Lesson"Name of the <nav> landmark.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-step-nav>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-step-nav-go{ direction } (previous or next)A link was used.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Real links inside a <nav>; each says the lesson it opens. In the page flow, never sticky.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): At least 48 px tall and full width on phones.
  • 2.4.4 Link Purpose: Each link names its lesson.
  • 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured: Never fixed or sticky.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
